author: gobernment
body:
Hello,

I have been hearing both that you are working on getting new players, and that it is not a priority. Assuming that advertising is still in function, how does the advertising work? Does a senior do it, the community, a department, a committee?

If advertising is not a priority and yet being done, do you have an estimate of when it'll be a focus? (e.g Atlas, a few weeks, after exams).

Thanks!

title: Plans to advertise?

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body: Gettng new players is a big priority to us. Currently not much advertising is being done, once Atlas has been released we plan to work on it. Advertising is handled by the Administrators and by a department. It's our next thing on our to do list, after Atlas.
